text:
maria: kicking off a config-only rollout for the "slim-guard" patch to routing + batching. starting canary now in us-west-2, quiet window 22:00-23:30 PT. pinning traffic to model-v1.3.7-slim for the canary. small batch window change and ratecap tighten.
deploybot: deploy started: deployment id dply-1735792468, mode=config-only, target=canary(us-west-2), traffic=5% -> 10% over 10m. rolling config: batching.window_ms=8 -> 6, routing.fallback_policy=region-prefer, tenant_rate_limit.default=800 -> 700.
jason: ack. observability hooks live? tracing + token-cost per-call enabled? :eyes:
leah: yes - added the canary dashboard link: https://console/redwood/canaries/dply-1735792468 and a quick alert on p50>1200ms or error_rate>0.5%.
maria: rollback criteria proposed: if p50 latency increases by >200ms vs baseline for 3 consecutive 5m buckets OR error_rate delta >0.3% absolute -> immediate rollback. agreement?
rachel: +1 on rollback thresholds. also suggestion: disable cross-region reroute for canary (keep requests local) to reduce noise.
kyle: small nit: batching.window_ms from 8->6 is aggressive for some long prompt flows. can we scope to short-seq tenants only? otherwise I'd prefer 7ms.
maria: updated plan: target tenant cohort=short-seq (cohort id shortseq-alpha). change to batching.window_ms=7ms for canary. leaving global defaults untouched.
ops-bot: monitoring note: synthetic runner started (canary-synth-173579). Samples every 15s hitting pinned model-v1.3.7-slim.
jason: good call scoping. deployment note for release notes: config-only, no model weights change, included in release notes http://go/release-notes/1735 (add entry about pin+batching change)
leah: quick config snippet we applied:
```yaml
routing:
  fallback_policy: region-prefer
  pin: model-v1.3.7-slim
batching:
  window_ms: 7
  max_batch_tokens: 1024
limits:
  tenant_rate_limit_default: 700
```
maria: ops checklist: 1) watch canary dashboard 10m, 2) confirm synth p50 within thresholds, 3) increase to 25% after 30m if stable, 4) follow staged rollout to 100% over 3h.
kyle: I'm on pager for the next 40m. ping me if p50 drift >150ms.
rachel: tagging @platform-sre for added eyes. :thumbsup:
deploybot: canary at 5% -> 10% completed. no alerts yet.
leah: synth p50=430ms (baseline 410ms), error_rate 0.04%. within thresholds so far.
maria: increase to 25% now.
ops-bot: scale-up note: extra warmers spun for canary cohort to avoid cold-stall.
jason: logging note: added an ephemeral debug flag for 30m to collect kv-cache pressure metrics. will auto-turnoff.
maria: if any rollback triggers hit, plan is immediate revert to previous routing config and unpin, then open a followup thread for root cause. thumbs?
kyle: thumbs up.
rachel: :thumbsup:
maria: final: leaving release note blurb in the doc, will mark this deploy id dply-1735792468 as "config-only: slim-guard routing/batching pin". monitoring for 3h after reaching 100% then close. thanks all.
